data: For fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025, Apple reported **diluted earnings per share of $7.46**, up from **$6.08 in fiscal 2024**. That is an increase of about **22.7%**, which Apple rounded to 23% in its results release. Part of the jump comes from a weak comparison year. Fiscal 2024 earnings were reduced by a one-time income tax charge of about $10.2 billion, related to the European Commission's state aid ruling on Ireland. Excluding that charge, fiscal 2024 diluted EPS would have been about $6.75. **Net income for fiscal 2025 was about $112.0 billion ($112,010 million)**, up from $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024. These figures come from Apple's fiscal 2025 annual report. I didn't look them up live for this answer, so it's worth checking them against the 10-K.
